symptom: `insert into grp1 { … }` for an Accordion group: widget "grp1" not found — the group stores no Name; `insert into acc1 item@2 { … }` was refused as "not a navigation list"; an empty group could not be filled at all
cause: object-list items (CustomWidgets$WidgetObject) had no address; resolveNavItem accepted only navigation lists
file: `mdl/backend/pagemutator/objectlist_items.go` (resolveObjectListItem, item slots, ObjectListItemValues), `column_hidden_reset.go` (ResetHiddenItemProperties, template nulling/creation), `mdl/executor/alter_hidden_item_slot.go`; grammar `alterTarget` itemSlot
insight: The default `docker check` normalises widgets on a temp copy and HID every defect here — run `--no-update-widgets` (the project as stored, what MxBuild and run --local see) or a hidden-slot write and a mode-switching SET both look clean while each is CE0463. Diffing a SET-switched group against a CREATE-made one (TypePointer -> PropertyKey in the JSON dump) found the cause in one step: headerText template filled vs null. Two plausible wrong turns: assuming the schema DefaultValue holds the visible default (it is "" — 'Header' lives in the widget package, so a revealed text with no value is refused, not invented), and a check-time hidden-slot refusal that blocked `set (headerRenderMode: 'custom'); insert into …headercontent` — the very fix its own message recommended — because check reads the stored document; it stands down when the statement sets the item first, and exec decides on live values. The item result carries the item schema like a DataGrid2 column, so SET and `.slot` reused existing paths rather than growing new ones
